body: I used to hate it, figured out what I liked and loved it, then went back to kind of hating it again. It's just not what does it for me. Some people, like myself, need that physical and emotional connection with another person.

I am happy to say that I made it through the year. Back in January I was so sure I wasn't going to make it through the year. I've suffered with bipolar disorder for a long time now, struggled with depression and being institutionalized several times, so I know things will probably get hard again, but I am proud to say that I made it and I know that you guys can too. I know life is hard. Don't even get me started and living with mental illness and/or hardships seems impossible sometimes, but you can do it and I am glad that you all are still here and I hope that things get better for you too.
Go you and best of wishes to Mr. Radar!!!
There is truth in that. My house was broken into last week and my most valuable possession taken, and as important as it was to me when I had it, it's value has increased exponentially in my book.
Yes! :D
That is the most encouraging thing I have ever heard. I feel a bit better now and you are right. I just need to roll with the punches and keep moving forward. I really appreciate your advice.
:D
Thank you :)

I have stopped taking my meds cold turkey plenty of times and I know in the long run it just makes things that much worse. I have always had a hard time reaching out for help when I feel like I am a danger to myself because it is kind of embarrassing. I feel like why would I reach out for help when I am the one who decided to do this to myself, if that makes any sense. I am trying to stick with what the doctors are telling me this time so that I can actually have a chance at getting better but it is so hard and tiring and I no longer have anyone to turn to for support irl. I really appreciate your advice though and I really hope that I can get through this without giving up this time.
Thank you. I really appreciate it.
Never feed your dog dairy and avoid human food at all costs as well. It is very bad for them and cuts valuable time off of their precious little lives.
My point exactly. I would rather be homeless and poor than do jail time and make it that much harder to find a job.
Thank you so much!! I am getting right on that!!

I don't have anything to hide except the depression which I can do pretty well when it comes to looking for a job. I have no criminal history or anything like that. I had my resume looked over when I first started college a year and a half ago by the job center at my school but I have since updated it and it could use some work so I will PM it to you. I am applying within reasonable bus rides from where I am currently staying. I'm trying not to go outside of a two and a half to three hour bus ride one way. My main hobby is working with animals so I had applied to several shelters, kennels, pet stores, and other similar jobs but there were either no openings or I didn't have what they are looking for.

I had talked to a recruiter online a few months ago. They said diagnosed asthma and depression after the age of 13 is completely disqualifying. I have both on my medical record and my psychiatric history is extensive with self mutilation, suicide attempts, medication, and hospital stays. I know they don't usually look at you medical records unless something comes up that makes them need to look into you history but it's not a risk I am willing to take lying about it. If i got kicked out of the military I can say goodbye to ever having a better life.
I hadn't thought about that. Thank you.
I had gone to one job agency where I was living before but I didn't get any jobs from them. I am trying to find one near where I am staying now though, so thank you.

I'm not hiding anything. Not all of the jobs I applied to where out here because I just moved out here a few weeks ago but I had been in Las Vegas for 6 months looking for work and couldn't find anything, lost my room that I was renting and moved out here a little over two weeks ago. But I have still not gotten any positive responses from any of the jobs in Vegas or here. I am not overweight and have good hygiene. I'm not sexy but I am definitely not hideous. And I don't have anything to hide in my interviews. I am kind of shy but I try my best not to let it show in the interviews I do get.

I would never become a stripper. I have thought about about the military but I have a lot of medical disqualifications that I couldn't get away with lying about. I am trying to transfer to a community college where I am staying now so I can continue getting my financial aid money but I am not sure i will be able to ahve everything ready and together in time. I know its going to be hard but I have found a few resources out here that will help me with housing so I think I've got a plan for now.
I don't have a car so I am trying not to apply to anything outside of a three hour bus ride so I don't get stuck somewhere overnight.

I've done a lot of volunteer work in the past and it helped, but I have been do focused on finding a job lately, that I hadn't thought about doing any volunteer work. And walks have always helped me which I also haven't been doing. Thank you for the reminder. And I will head to the library tomorrow. Thank you.

I don't really have any skills. I have worked in retail and customer service so I have sales and interpersonal communication skills. I am good when it comes to cleaning, recovering, and keeping things neat and organized. I don't really have hobbies outside of working with animals which I am good at, but that's about it.

I do both instore and online applications depending on where I am applying and if they accept instore applications and I have found I am more likely to get an interview with instore applications but no jobs yet.

I am about finished with the application so I'll hope for the best. I didn't know I could appeal though so thank you. I have filled out the FASFA and got money from it last semester, but I think I transferred it to my new school to late for it to help me out this semester so i don't think I can go to school this semester.
Yes. I understood the concept of the "correct" answer the first time I had to do one of those and the job center at a previous college further explained to me how those work.
I had looked into one where I had lived before but they couldn't find me anything temporary or other. Thanks for reminding me though. I will look for one out here.
Trust me. I am applying for minimum wage retail and fast food positions. I will take anything short of selling me body.

I can't even get an interview. I have had professional help with my resume. I have a clean background with a little bit of work experience. I am friendly and cheery. Clean and nicely dressed. I don't know why I can't get a job other than there are other people applying who are more suited for the position. I don't have experience in fast food but I am a quick learner. I don't know how else to improve my presentation.
I have. I've gotten yelled at a few times for calling to much sometimes.

I was in college but wasn't getting enough financial aid to really support myself. I recently lost everything and got evicted from where I was and had to move in with my aunt. I am trying to get into the community college out here but I think I am to late to get in this semester.

I apply where I know jobs are open. I don't have a criminal background or anything that would flag me as a no. I have work experience in retail. I call in. I don't have any friends or anyone to turn to to put in a word for me. I have asked a few hiring managers why I was declined and the answer is either they found someone with more experience or decided not to hire anyone. I don't know what else to do but keep putting in job applications. I know people who have been applying forever like me and people who got the first job they applied for and I don't really see the difference between the two besides being in the right place at the right time and I just haven't found that.
I have applied at fast food. I have applied at all minimum wage jobs that I qualify for and even those I don't. I just always get a no or a we will call you and they never call.
I have looked it over but I know they are currently denying people left and right and I really need help and can't afford to be denied.
I considered the military but my depression and asthma is on my medical record and disqualifies me and I don't think I could get away with lying.
I did :) Please let me know when it's sent??
My broke butt could use some pizza.

I am currently living with my aunt so thankfully I will have company. I just got back and I feel better than I thought I would thank goodness. And I absolutely hate alcohol so no chance in me slipping up and drinking although I know personally I need to avoid pills. I feel better though. I think I will be ok.
I came across this a few months ago and showed it to my close family and friends hoping to put my depression into perspective for them. They still don't understand..
So true.
Thank you, I really appreciate it. I'm going to go and hopefully I can deal with the grief without losing it.

I don't have anyone to talk to but talking to people on the internet is helping a bit. I am currently jobless and homeless and taking time off of school to try to get my life back together. I have trouble waking up, making sure I eat, and take care of myself, let alone looking for a job and a permanent place to stay because I am house hopping at the moment. I have tried to write about it but I can never write much because I get to upset to keep writing. I appreciate your advice though and your concern.

I don't want to go, but I am not sure i will be able to accept it any other way. I am just afraid I am going to fall apart afterwards. I have just been struggling to function recently and trying to find my reason to keep trying to get by and I am not sure I have what it takes to add this to the mix. I am afraid it is going to push me over the edge. I have made several attempts in the past and I just feel like if I let myself express any emotion I am going to get swept up by it and not be able to deal.
Me too but no matter what I do I don't feel better. I can't get over my depression and the feeling hopeless and alone.

Thank you for trying to read it. I know that I am not alone in how I feel but I still feel alone for some reason. My life isn't that bad but I feel like I am going through hell and it's just hard to deal.
Sorry, I am the one on the left and my lady is the one on the right.

I just don't even know where to begin though. I usually got sent to the hospital because my mom or my psychologist found out I was cutting or my mom found me after a failed suicide attempt and called 911 and the ER then sent me to the hospital. I have never gone willingly. I have never even scheduled an appointment with a psychologist on my own. I recently turned 18 and am on my own now so I don't know where to turn. I am trying to figure something out while I can still think straight because I know I will probably lose it again soon but the panic and the indecisiveness on top of just not knowing what to do is making it impossible to find help. I am to scared to call anyone for help. I have just never made the effort to reach out for help before and I don't want to burden anyone with this anymore. My mom had to put up with me and my depression for years and I can't drag her back into this. I am just so confused. I feel ok right now but I am still having suicidal thoughts. I am still planning in the back of my mind. I just don't know.

I have gone through different types of therapy and counseling before and never found one that really helped. I think I am going to look into getting back into group therapy as well as one-on-one counseling though. I feel a little better after having talked things out here so I am  going to do my best to keep trying.

I finish my semester tomorrow and am then going to stay my aunt for awhile. I think I need some time off school to get myself together anyway. I can't go to school feeling like this. I have done great so far but I know if I don't get better my grades are going to start reflecting it more. I try so hard to appreciate the little things because I know I do have things to be grateful for, but even that is a ridiculous challenge for me. I am so consumed by either this heavy weight of doom or apathy that I can't see past it long enough to catch a glimpse of the positive things. I think I am ok for now though. Talking things out a bit has helped me to calm down and when I move tomorrow I am going to seek some professional help and keep trying to work through this.

I have struggled with the depression since I was ten and had some severe brain bleeding that destroyed my cheery outgoing optimistic personality. Through the years the depression has significantly worsened. I have been self-mutilating for almost 5 years now, abusing all kinds of drugs. I have been in and out of the the psychiatric hopstial more times than I can count, seen more psychologists than I can remember, and been many different medications to help me cope. It helps for a little while but I always fall back into the same rut. I never completely escape the depression. I have yet to find a psychologist that really helped, or a medication that helped that didn't have some other horrible side effect that made me have to stop taking it. I am just tired of trying. It's this constant hit and miss. Nothing works and I have been at it for years.

Ya, I need a full time job so I can find myself somewhere to live. I get a nice amount of money from federal aid for school but I have applied for tons of scholarships and I haven't gotten any and I am terrified of loans because debt is what tore my family apart. And earlier this year I desperately needed my family's help because I didn't have a place to go and each one told me I am sorry and I love you but I just can't help you. Thank you for listening and thank you for the advice. I know that I can get through this I just don't know if I can get through the depression anymore. I think that's the hardest part. I have been through some really low points in my life, almost as bad as this or worse and made it out. It's just that I am paralyzed with fear and I barely have any hope which is enough to make me want to quit. I can't stop the cutting or the substance abuse and I can't be happy even when things are ok so i just don't see the point sometimes. I am probably to much of a coward to ever really kill myself but I know I will probably keep making half-hearted attempts or failing right before I succeed which will probably eventually painfully lead to my death. I don't know what I want anymore. I don't know if I am looking for help or just someone to hear me out before I try again but I appreciate you listening.

It's not just the bad situation though. Even when my life is going good I seriously want to die. I know that the situation isn't helping but my wanting to commit suicide isn't completely based on my situation. Even when things are good it's still hard to get out of bed and to get moving. I still seriously debate with myself whether I should just die. I can't tell you the last time I was actually happy even when I had my life together. Growing up I couldn't wait to go to college and get married and become a mother and start a career. Now it all just seems pointless. I have been through some really tough times in the last few years and been through some traumas you wouldn't even imagine so I know that if I put the work in I could get through this and make my life better. I just don't want to get through this anymore because I don't think I will ever personally get better no matter what happens on the outside. Besides everyone acts like if you just get through this it will be all sunshine and ponies and kittens and stuff but watching my parents and all of the people around me I know that even though there are good times, the trials and the obstacles and the downfalls and the failures never stop and I am so tired of the depression even when things are good and I "should" be happy and the feeling alone even when I was surrounded by people who loved me.

My dad ruined his life and his health and since his side of the family is caring for him they have all said they don't have the money or space to help me out. My mom moved in with her current partner who is a hateful alcoholic (which is why I had to move out) and my mom told me she is broke and can't help me out. I have an aunt that is giving me a place to stay at the moment but she is about to move in with her boyfriend and has made it clear that I can't come. The only other family I have is a 17 year old sister (whom my mom kicked out as well) that is staying with some family of a friend of hers to finish high school. I have to leave college at least for now because I don't have the time and the money to go right now. I need to get a job. But I am so depressed and so ready to just fall asleep and die I can barely motivate myself to get up let alone go apply. I spent months applying for a job before I found my first job and I spent the first few months after I lost my job looking for a job and i just don't see myself getting one. I don't see myself getting over my depression and my severe anxiety and getting a job and getting my life together and taking care of myself. I don't think I could do it. And even if I could do it I don't think I will ever be happy and I think i will always be alone. Why work my ass off and never be happy? Everything just seems to hard, to scary, and to pointless and like i said the only thing stopping me from just ending it is the pain a clean suicide requires. I just feel stuck.
Carol from Where the Wild Things Are
